summaryShort: There's attraction here, but you may not always like or value things in the same way. One person can find the other charming partly because they're different, but that same difference can also make the connection feel a little uneven.
summaryDeep:
There's attraction here, but you may not always like or value things in the same way. One person can find the other charming partly because they're different, but that same difference can also make the connection feel a little uneven.

At its best, this is the pull of someone who brings a different style, mood, or way of showing affection. They may make life feel more interesting, more beautiful, or just less like your usual routine. At its worst, you keep running into the gap between what one person means as love and what the other person actually receives.

The problem is expecting appreciation to look the same on both sides. The attraction may be real, but you may not always agree on what feels thoughtful, romantic, or worth caring about.

Appreciate the difference without making it a test. Find what you both enjoy, instead of trying to win the argument about taste.
